chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Regarding sheep: when they come forward, they come with blessing, and when they go away, they still come with blessing. Cattle: when they come forward, they come with blessing, and when they go away, they depart with it. Camels: when they come forward, they drive it away, and when they go away, they depart with it.

key_terms.الْإِبِلُ: camels; livestock described in contrast to the others
key_terms.الْبَقَرُ: cattle; bovine livestock contrasted with sheep and camels
key_terms.الْغَنَمِ: sheep; small livestock being described as associated with blessing

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam عليه السلام say about sheep, cattle, and camels bringing or removing blessing?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام contrasts sheep, cattle, and camels in terms of the blessing associated with them. The report presents a brief wisdom saying about the differing effects and qualities attributed to these kinds of livestock.
